couplets.en: My pain owed the remedy nothing.

lines: Main na achchha hua, bura na hua
couplets.en: I did not get well, and perhaps that was just as well.

lines: Kya woh Namrood ki khudai thi?
couplets.en: Was that the godhood Namrood claimed?

lines: Bandagi mein mera bhala na hua
couplets.en: All my devotion brought me no good.
Where am I to go to try my luck?

lines: Jab tu hi khanjar-aazma na hua
couplets.en: You yourself would not put your dagger to the test.

lines: Jama karte ho kyun raqeebon ko?
couplets.en: Why do you gather my rivals around you?

lines: Ek tamasha hua, gila na hua
couplets.en: My grievance went unheard, and there was a spectacle instead.

lines: Kuchh to kahiye ke log kehte hain
couplets.en: Do say something, for people are already talking.
Today Ghalib did not sing a ghazal.
